component.name: Maschine Linux
component.summary: Native Instruments Maschine MK3 DAW & Controller integration for Linux
DAW et intégration contrôleur Native Instruments Maschine MK3 pour Linux

description.p: Maschine Linux is a modern, ultra-low-latency Digital Audio Workstation and hardware host tailored specifically for the Native Instruments Maschine MK3 and Mikro MK3 controllers on Linux.
Maschine Linux est une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) ultra basse latence conçue spécialement pour les contrôleurs Native Instruments Maschine MK3 et Mikro MK3 sous Linux.

ul.li: Full plug-and-play hardware support for Maschine MK3 (Pads, Knobs, 4-way encoder, dual 480x272 color displays)
Integrated 808 analog drum synthesis engine and high-performance polyphonic sampler
Real-time DSP guitar multi-effects rack and Acid TB-303 synthesizer emulation
Seamless PipeWire / WirePlumber / ALSA low-latency audio support with dynamic sample-rate negotiation
Automatic in-app update mechanism from GitHub releases

description.p: Release 0.6.0 with GUI studio interface, 808 analog synthesis, dual-screen mirror, PipeWire low latency and hotplug support.
